rules.statement: Whether a document comes from proper custody is a question of fact to be determined according to the circumstances of each case, and it does not necessarily mean legal custody. Proper custody can be established if the origin is probable and legitimate.
rules.supporting_quote: Whether or not a particular custody is proper is a question of fact to be determined according to the circumstances of each case. Proper custody does not necessarily mean legal custody. It is sufficient if the circumstances render it probable that the origin was legitimate.
